description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Frost Fair Lure Fish, adding {C}{C}.
When Frost Fair Lure Fish dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Frost Fair Lure Fish from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Frost Fair Lure Fish enters, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Fish creature tokens and two tapped Treasure tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
